transcript.text: Maya, here are my findings from the buyer-group exposure review I completed this morning. The buyer's affiliated funds already hold $6,000,000 of Northstar Equipment exposure. Our portfolio policy caps aggregate exposure to that buyer group at $10,000,000. This means any additional Northstar participation sold to this buyer group must stay within the remaining $4,000,000 of headroom under the cap. I should note that this review has not yet been circulated, so you're hearing it here first. This is a key risk constraint that should factor into your decision on the sale and its terms.

On a $4,000,000 assignment, this would produce cash proceeds of exactly $3,920,000.
